{
  "facts": [
    {"Had a flat tire on the bike two weeks ago"},
    {"Biking to work is an excellent option for a healthier and more environmentally friendly commute"},
    {"Planed bike route in advance to ensure it's safe and convenient"},
    {"Wear a helmet, follow traffic rules, and be mindful of road conditions"},
    {"Regularly check bike's tire pressure, brakes, and chain to ensure it's in good working condition"},
    {"Dress comfortably and consider wearing clothing with reflective materials"},
    {"Bring a waterproof bag or panniers to carry gear, and don't forget a lock for the bike"},
    {"Consider shower facilities or invest in a portable shower kit if arriving at work sweaty"},
    {"Start with a shorter route or a more leisurely pace to build up endurance if not comfortable biking the entire distance"},
    {"Combine biking with public transit if not comfortable biking the entire distance"}
  ]
}
